note: 本站所有平台信息为整理性介绍，不构成推荐或收益承诺。收益随个人投入、平台政策与市场波动，多数人只适合作为零花钱渠道。编辑原则：不使用夸大收益的宣传话术。

categories.name: 正规问卷 & 众包任务
categories.desc: 填写问卷、数据标注、语音采集等轻量任务，单价普遍偏低，适合零碎时间赚点奶茶钱。
categories.descEn: Surveys, data labeling and voice collection. Pay is usually low — good for pocket money in spare moments.

platforms.name: 腾讯搜活帮
pros: 腾讯官方背景，结算相对稳定
任务类型多：标注、转写、问卷
prosEn: Backed by Tencent, relatively stable payouts
Many task types: labeling, transcription, surveys
cons: 单价低，单条任务多为几毛到几元
高峰期任务多，淡季可能长时间抢不到任务
审核不通过不发钱，需按规则仔细做
consEn: Low unit price — tasks often pay a few cents to a few yuan
Task availability swings; quiet periods common
Rejected work is unpaid — follow rules carefully

platforms.name: 阿里众包 / 支付宝蚂蚁微客
pros: 支付宝生态，提现门槛低
线下巡检类任务单价相对高
prosEn: Alipay ecosystem, low withdrawal threshold
Field inspection tasks pay relatively more
cons: 线下任务需要跑动，有地域限制
任务名额有限，靠抢
部分任务需垫付后报销，注意核对规则
consEn: Field tasks require travel and are location-limited
Limited slots — first come first served
Some tasks require upfront payment then reimbursement — check rules

platforms.name: Swagbucks / ySense
pros: 老牌平台，任务种类多
可兑换礼品卡，适合海淘用户
prosEn: Established platforms with many task types
Gift card redemption options
cons: 中文用户通过率低，问卷常做到一半被筛掉
单价低，每小时收益有限
提现到账周期可能数天到数周
需如实申报地区信息，虚假信息会封号
consEn: Chinese users often screened out mid-survey
Low hourly return
Payout can take days to weeks
False profile details risk account bans

categories.name: 图文 / 文案接单平台
categories.desc: 写文章、短文案、改写校对类接单。收入上限高于问卷，但需要稳定产出和沟通成本。
categories.descEn: Articles, short copy, rewriting and proofreading. Higher ceiling than surveys, but needs steady output and client communication.

platforms.name: 猪八戒网 / 一品威客
pros: 国内老牌接单平台，客户量大
品类覆盖文案、设计、视频
prosEn: Established domestic marketplace with many clients
Covers writing, design and video
cons: 平台抽成与竞标费用需算清
低价竞争严重，起号阶段报价被压
需防客户以改稿为由拖延验收
consEn: Factor in platform fees and bidding costs
Fierce price pressure when starting out
Watch for clients delaying acceptance via endless revisions

platforms.name: 稿定 / 文案约稿社群
pros: 单篇价格可谈，优质稿件能积累回头客
在家完成，时间灵活
prosEn: Rates negotiable; good work wins repeat clients
Work from home with flexible hours
cons: 结算全靠双方约定，无平台担保时要谨慎
稿费拖欠、洗稿纠纷常见
需自留底稿与沟通记录维权
consEn: Payment terms are informal without escrow
Late payment and content-theft disputes are common
Keep drafts and chat records as evidence

categories.name: 视频剪辑 / 设计接单
categories.desc: 短视频剪辑、海报设计、PPT 美化等技能型接单。单价较高，但对作品集和交付速度有要求。
categories.descEn: Short-video editing, poster design and slide decks. Better pay, but portfolio and turnaround speed matter.

platforms.name: Upwork / Fiverr
pros: 客户来自全球，报价空间较大
可做长期合同单
prosEn: Global clients with wider rate range
Long-term contracts available
cons: 平台抽成约 10%-20%
新账号起步难，需低价积累评价
英文沟通门槛
遇恶意差评申诉周期长
consEn: Platform cut around 10-20%
Hard start for new accounts — low rates to build reviews
English communication needed
Appealing unfair reviews takes time

platforms.name: 闲鱼 / 社群剪辑接单
pros: 门槛低，作品集够就能接
结算快
prosEn: Low barrier — a portfolio is enough
Fast settlement
cons: 单价被压得很低，改稿次数常无上限
走平台外交易有被骗风险
版权素材误用可能引发纠纷
consEn: Rates pushed down; unlimited revisions common
Off-platform deals carry scam risk
Misused stock assets can cause disputes

categories.name: 自媒体分成
categories.desc: YouTube、短视频平台、内容联盟的广告分成与创作激励。需要先积累流量，属于长期项目。
categories.descEn: Ad revenue and creator incentives from YouTube, short-video apps and content networks. Requires traffic first — a long-term play.

platforms.name: YouTube 合作伙伴计划
pros: 长视频收益生命周期长
全球流量，单次播放单价相对高
prosEn: Long video shelf life
Global traffic with relatively high CPM
cons: 加入门槛：订阅数与观看时长需达标
收益波动大，取决于题材与地区
版权音乐/素材易导致收益归零或封号
前期可能长期无收益
consEn: Entry requires subscriber and watch-time thresholds
Earnings swing by niche and audience region
Copyright claims can wipe out revenue or ban the channel
Months of no income at the start

platforms.name: 抖音 / 快手创作者分成
pros: 国内流量大，冷启动机会多
可结合带货、直播多元变现
prosEn: Huge domestic traffic, chances for cold start
Combine with commerce and livestreaming
cons: 单价低，需要大量播放才有可观收入
算法变动导致流量与收益不稳定
搬运、混剪易被判低质限流
consEn: Low per-view pay — needs large volume
Algorithm changes make income unstable
Reposted or low-effort content gets suppressed

categories.name: 跨境分销联盟
categories.desc: 通过推广链接赚佣金，包括亚马逊联盟、小说推文等。需要内容与流量基础，不是被动收入。
categories.descEn: Earn commissions via referral links — Amazon Associates, novel promotion, etc. Needs content and traffic; not passive income.

platforms.name: Amazon Associates
platforms.minWithdraw: 约 $10 起提 / 或礼品卡
platforms.minWithdrawEn: From about USD 10 or gift card
pros: 商品库庞大，转化链路成熟
可做垂类测评站积累长尾流量
prosEn: Huge catalog and mature conversion funnel
Niche review sites can build long-tail traffic
cons: 佣金率品类差异大，多数仅个位数百分比
cookie 有效期短（通常 24 小时）
规则严格，违规推广会清退佣金
新手常见误区：以为发链接就有人买
consEn: Commission varies widely, often single digits
Short cookie window (usually 24 hours)
Strict rules — violations forfeit commissions
Newcomers wrongly assume links alone convert

platforms.name: 小说推文（GoodNovel 等）
platforms.currency: 人民币 CNY / 部分美元
pros: 内容形式成熟，短视频引流路径清晰
爆款单条可带来持续佣金
prosEn: Mature format with clear short-video funnel
One viral clip can bring ongoing commissions
cons: 需在官方渠道拿授权，私自搬运有侵权风险
归因规则复杂，用户搜索路径易丢单
平台政策变动频繁
收益高度依赖爆款，不稳定
consEn: Get authorization via official channels — reposting risks infringement
Complex attribution — easy to lose credit
Platform policies change often
Income depends heavily on virality

categories.name: 闲置出物 / 二手变现
categories.desc: 把闲置物品挂到二手平台变现。来钱相对快，但价格与纠纷处理是主要难点。
categories.descEn: Sell items you no longer use. Comparatively quick cash, but pricing and disputes are the main challenges.

platforms.name: 闲鱼
pros: 用户基数大，出货快
担保交易，货款有平台托管
prosEn: Large user base, quick sales
Escrow protects both sides
cons: 砍价与到手刀常见
退货纠纷偏向买家时需自行举证
禁售品类多，违规会封号
勿在站外私下交易
consEn: Haggling and post-delivery price cuts are common
You may need to prove your case in return disputes
Many banned categories — violations get bans
Avoid off-platform deals

platforms.name: 转转 / 多抓鱼
pros: 验机/验书流程标准化，省心
图书、数码类目出货稳定
prosEn: Standardized inspection process
Steady market for books and gadgets
cons: 回收价压得较低，卖价不如自挂
验货后可能二次压价
寄售周期长，资金回笼慢
consEn: Buyback prices are low — less than self-listing
Price may be cut again after inspection
Consignment ties up capital
